attribution: analyst proposal approved by the curator on 2026-11-20
participants: original repaired repeat-eligible roster with unique positive actual attempt numbers
split: one latest eligible repeat per player; earlier eligible repeats only for training
eligible_repeat: actual immediately preceding attempt recorded and prior observed score history available
reference_source: only completed earlier plays, in the original play-relative point units
model: original eight TD3/MD3 choice predictors with a player-specific intercept; common training roster and identical predictors apart from the registered reference
interval: paired percentile 95% interval from 2,000 whole held-out player draws, shared across references
primary_score: mean sum of 30 held-out trial log likelihoods per play on which that pair's references differ
companion: all scored test plays, same paired differences and intervals; count equal and different values for each pair
success: both best-minus-other pairwise intervals have lower endpoints strictly above zero and both pairs have at least 100 differing scored players
limit: The test is each player's latest eligible repeat play and speaks to late plays. A game score is not anyone's meaning.
